app.name: Koode
app.tagline: Learn your way. Grow with Koode.
auth.title: Teacher sign in
auth.linkSent: Check your email for a sign-in link. In local dev the link also appears on this page.
auth.verifyFailed: That sign-in link is invalid or expired.
auth.teacherHint: Students in a class: use Join class with your section code — no email needed.
auth.learnerHint: Learn on your own with email. Teachers use Teacher sign in. Class students use Join class.

auth.ageConfirm: I confirm I am 13 or older
auth.claimTitle: Link an email to this account
auth.claimHint: Add a verified email so you can sign in later without your class code.
auth.claimDone: Email linked. You can use Learner sign up with this email next time.
admin.bootstrapHint: One-time setup. Requires the server BOOTSTRAP_SECRET.
admin.bootstrapDone: Admin created. Use the verification link to sign in.
admin.bootstrapDisabled: Bootstrap is disabled on this server.
admin.bootstrapError: Bootstrap failed. Check the secret and try again.
admin.title: Platform admin
admin.forbidden: Admins only. Platform admins can manage pathways and challenges here.
admin.needSignIn: Sign in as a platform admin to continue.
admin.pathwayError: Could not save the pathway. Try again.
admin.challengesHint: Create challenges; optionally link to a pathway.
admin.challengeError: Could not save the challenge. Try again.
home.welcome: Welcome back. Your learning progress will live here.
home.signedOutHint: Learners sign up with email. Teachers sign in. Class students join with a code.
pathways.title: Learning pathways
pathways.hint: Start a published pathway to track your progress.
pathways.needSignIn: Sign in to browse and start pathways.
pathways.error: Could not start that pathway. Try again.
challenges.title: Challenges
challenges.hint: Start a published challenge. Completion uses a stub check for now.
challenges.error: Could not update that challenge. Try again.
projects.title: Your projects
projects.hint: Save a project stub linked to a pathway or challenge.
projects.error: Could not save the project. Try again.
progress.title: Your progress
progress.hint: Enrollments, challenge attempts, and projects in one place.
progress.needSignIn: Sign in to see your progress.
tutor.title: Guided tutor
tutor.needSignIn: Sign in to use the tutor.
tutor.error: The tutor could not answer. Try again.
classroom.title: Your classrooms
classroom.pathwayDirectionHint: Optional guidance for the class — not a forced lock.

classroom.supportLegend: These colours are an indicative support signal from learning activity only. They are not a clinical diagnosis or medical advice.
classroom.needTeacher: Sign in as a teacher to manage classrooms.
classroom.empty: No sections yet. Create one for your class.
insights.title: Teacher insights
insights.subtitle: Learning-support graphs for your section. No chat content is shown.
insights.needTeacher: Sign in as a teacher to view insights.
insights.empty: Create a classroom section first, then return here.
insights.noChallenges: No challenge attempts in this section yet.
